explanation.explanation: Panel A (i-ii) consists of phase contrast time-lapse microscopy images, not a quantitative plot with axes; time points are given as text labels (0, 20, 65, 95, 110, 120 min) beneath each image, not as a graph axis.
Panel B is a grid of phase contrast and fluorescence micrographs (BF, eCFP-FtsZ, NAO channels) at different time points; it is not a plot with quantitative axes.
Panel C is a time-lapse series of phase contrast and fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot with axes.
